jobs.description:
Do you also love the idea of working in chocolate? Then this opportunity is definitely for you! We are looking for production workers who can help out during the upcoming chocolate season. What will you be doing?
 

 
• Packing pralines, seashell chocolates, chocolate bars, etc. into boxes
 
• Labeling finished products and pallets
 
• Tying ribbons around praline boxes
 
• Applying stickers to finished products
 
• Wrapping boxes in foil
 
• Carrying out quality control checks 

Who are you?
 

 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5 a.m.–1 p.m. / 1 p.m.–9 p.m.) or possibly a fixed night shift (9 p.m.–5 a.m.)
 
• You have a good knowledge of the Dutch or English language
 
• You have your own mode of transport
 
• You are flexible regarding working hours
 
• You are willing to work in the food industry

Responsibilities

• Manage and maintain Windows and Linux servers within virtualized environments.
• Execute system updates and patches through formal change control processes.
• Perform backup, restore, monitoring, and troubleshooting of the server infrastructure.
• Support infrastructure qualification processes, including IQ/OQ, and prepare necessary documentation.
• Ensure data integrity by managing access controls and monitoring audit trails.
• Participate in deviations, CAPA processes, and infrastructure audits.
• Operate in accordance with SOPs and maintain accurate technical documentation.

Requirements

• 3+ years experience in server or system administration.
• Advanced knowledge of Windows Server and Linux.
• Hands-on experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V.
• Professional experience working within a GxP environment.
• You are accurate, structured, and comfortable following strict procedures.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English.
Nice to Haves

• Knowledge of EU GMP Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11, or GAMP 5.
• Bachelor's degree in IT or a related field.

jobs.occupation: Inside Sales Representative (English + East EU language)
jobs.description:
As an Inside Sales Representative, you are responsible for providing excellent service and commercial support to customers in a specific region: Middle East, Africa and Eastern Europe. You work hand in hand with the External Sales Representative and help strengthen customer relationships, drive sales growth, and promote the use of our digital tools. 

Key responsibilities:
 
 

• Open new customer accounts (approx. 30%) and grow business with existing customers (approx. 70%) 

• Prepare accurate offers and price calculations 

• Enter and follow up on orders 

• Actively manage your accounts via phone and email, with a focus on cross-selling and digital migration 

• Maintain and update customer data in the internal system 

• Understand customer needs, market context, product applications, and competitors 

• Be the main point of contact for customer inquiries, complaints, and support 

• Identify and close commercial opportunities 

• Report on sales projects and progress in close collaboration with External Sales 

• Contribute to the team with flexibility and a hands-on attitude 
 

• You have a technical and/or commercial background 

• You have at least 4 years of B2B sales experience, preferably with technical products 

• You are fluent in English (spoken and written) – mandatory 

• Polish, Czech or another Eastern European language is a strong asset 

• French and/or Arabic is an asset 

• Strong skills in Excel and general IT tools 

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 

• You are proactive, persuasive, structured, and a true team player 

• Able to multitask and work under pressure in a small but ambitious team

Our client is a leading player in the event industry, specialized in the design and production of exhibition stand systems. The company is known for its innovative approach and high-quality products that are used worldwide at trade fairs, exhibitions, and events.

In this role, you will ensure the precise finishing of aluminium profiles and frames. You will alternate between series production ans custom-made pieces, with quality always being the top priority. You'll receive a salary starting at €17.50 per hour, depending on your experience, supplemented by meal vouchers.

Do you enjoy working precisely with metal and do you derive satisfaction from a perfectly finished end product? Then be sure to read on!

What does your day look like as a grinder?

 
• 
You will grind and deburr aluminium profiles in accordance with the technical drawings

 
• 
You carry out visual quality checks on your own grinding work

 
• 
You alternate between series production and custom-made pieces

 
• 
You process production orders via an ERP system

 
• 
You follow quality through control sheets

 
• 
You carry out first-line maintenance, e.g. replacing sanding brushes, maintaining work equipment, etc.

Do you already have experience as a metalworker or do you already have knowledge of an ERP system ? This is definitely a plus!

 
• 
You're good at reading technical drawings and enjoy working with precision

 
• 
You're good working with measuring tools

 
• 
You're quality-oriented and value order and tidiness

 
• 
Are you fluent in English and do you have a basic knowledge of Dutch? Great! That will ensure internal communication runs smoothly

 
• 
A job in 2 shifts is just what you're looking for, and do you already have experience in

Our client is a specialized consultancy company with a unique market position, having worked exclusively with the same international aviation industry leader for more than 15 years. This long-term partnership offers an exceptional combination of stability, expertise, and continuous technological evolution.

Operating within a highly international environment, the company supports business-critical data and analytics initiatives that enable strategic and operational decision-making across multiple regions and business functions. Thanks to its close relationship with its client, employees benefit from the scale, complexity, and career opportunities of a large multinational organization while enjoying the agility, accessibility, and human-sized culture of a smaller consultancy structure.

As a Data Engineer / BI Consultant, you will contribute to the design, development, maintenance, and optimization of the organization's data ecosystem.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Developing, maintaining, and optimizing data pipelines within a Snowflake environment.
• Working with SQL and Linux/Bash to support data integration, automation, and transformation processes.
• Implementing and maintaining solutions within a modern Data Mesh architecture combining Data Lake and Data Warehouse principles.
• Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of data flows and reporting solutions.
• Collaborating closely with international business stakeholders located across multiple countries and time zones.
• Gathering business requirements and translating them into sustainable and efficient data solutions.
• Supporting the continuous improvement of reporting, analytics, and Business Intelligence capabilities.
• Contributing to data quality, governance, and optimization initiatives.
• Participating in ongoing projects related to cloud data platforms and digital transformation.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with excellent communication skills and enjoys working in an international environment.

We are looking for someone who can demonstrate:

• 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, or a similar domain.
• Hands-on experience with Snowflake at an intermediate level.
• Strong knowledge of:
• SQL
• Linux/Bash
• Data Factory
• Experience working with business stakeholders and translating functional requirements into technical solutions.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with international teams.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
The following skills would be considered an advantage:

• Experience with Data Mesh architectures.
• Knowledge of Power BI.
• Experience with Matillion.
• Experience with Teradata.
Languages:

• English is mandatory.
• French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets.

Your Job as a Cross Contamination Compliance Engineer

Do you enjoy combining quality compliance with technical risk management in a pharmaceutical production environment? As a Cross Contamination Compliance Engineer, you will play a key role in maintaining and strengthening the cross contamination strategy at a leading API manufacturing site in Geel. You will work closely with operations and multiple departments to identify, assess, and mitigate contamination risks. Your expertise will help ensure sustainable compliance and support safe manufacturing processes. This is a visible role with a direct impact on quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Fortunately, we can count on you for:

 
• Maintaining and reviewing cross contamination risk assessments
 
• Ensuring contamination risks remain controlled during MoC activities
 
• Preparing, facilitating, and documenting cross contamination FMEAs
 
• Supporting operations during complex quality incidents and investigations
 
• Identifying improvement opportunities within contamination control processes
 
• Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across manufacturing and quality
 
• Contributing to the site's contamination control strategy and compliance goals

You communicate clearly with different stakeholders and know how to build strong working relationships. You approach challenges in a structured way and can balance quality requirements with operational realities. You enjoy coordinating activities and bringing people together around a common objective.

What do you bring?

 
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Technology, Chemistry, Bioengineering or equivalent experience
 
• Minimum 3 years of experience in a pharmaceutical or industrial manufacturing environment
 
• Knowledge of GMP, change management, FMEA, and risk assessment methodologies
 
• Understanding of cross contamination risks and contamination control principles; Annex 1 knowledge is an asset
 
• Fluent in English; Dutch is considered a strong asset

jobs.occupation: Food Production Operator (Early, Late or Night Shift)
jobs.description:
Company located in Roeselare.

Jobomschrijving

What will you do as a Packaging Operator in the Food Industry?
	
• Operate, set up and monitor packaging and weighing machines	
• Check the quality and correct weight of packaged products	
• Identify and resolve minor malfunctions or report them in a timely manner	
• Perform quality control checks, including metal detection tests	
• Help maintain a clean, safe and organized working environment

	
• Experience as an operator or with packaging machines is an advantage, but not required	
• You work accurately and have a strong eye for quality	
• You speak Dutch, French, or English	
• A forklift certificate is a plus	
• You are willing to work in a chilled environment (5°C to 10°C)	
• You are willing to work in shifts (6:00 AM to 2:00 PM, 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM, or 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM)

Company located in the Roeselare region.

Jobomschrijving

What are your responsibilities as a forklift driver?
	
• Receiving and correctly storing incoming goods in the warehouse	
• Loading and unloading trucks	
• Scanning products in and out using a scanning system	
• Operating a forklift (approximately 80% of the time) and an electric pallet truck (approximately 20%)	
• Maintaining a clean, safe, and organized workplace	
• Working in a chilled environment with a closed and heated forklift

	
• You hold a valid forklift certificate	
• You have experience stacking and working at heights of up to 10 meters	
• You speak Dutch, French, or English	
• You work accurately and value order and structure	
• Safety is always your top priority	
• You enjoy working independently but also function well within a team

With around 1,000 ‘Brabantians’, we are responsible for the worldwide production, marketing, sales and distribution of our Designed for Living products.

Brabantia has factories in Latvia, China and Belgium. At the Pelt site, we produce not only waste bins, but also bread bins and storage canisters. Adjacent to the production site is our distribution centre, from which Brabantia products are distributed worldwide.

More than 350 employees work at the Pelt site.

Jobomschrijving

Brabantia in Pelt is looking for Warehouse Operators!

Are you looking for a varied job in an international company? Then we are looking for you!

As a Warehouse Operator, you will be responsible for the following tasks:
	
• Manually picking orders	
• Packing and labelling products	
• Processing shipping documents	
• Working with handheld scanners
You will also help keep the working environment clean and tidy. You always work safely and support your colleagues whenever needed.

As a Warehouse Operator at Brabantia, you will have a varied range of tasks.
	
• You are available to work in 2 shifts: from 5:30 AM to 2:00 PM and from 2:00 PM to 10:30 PM. On Fridays, the early shift is from 5:30 AM to 1:00 PM and the late shift from 1:00 PM to 8:30 PM	
• You will work with handheld scanners and computer programs	
• Experience with these tools or the motivation to learn how to use them is therefore essential	
• You have experience operating an electric pallet truck or are willing to follow an internal training	
• You have your own means of transportation, as Brabantia is not accessible by public transport	
• You speak English fluently

Nike ELC is an innovative employer with distribution centres in Laakdal and Tessenderlo-Ham and is responsible for all European Nike orders.

Jobomschrijving

As a warehouse worker for Nike ELC, you are trained to execute several tasks, such as loading and sorting of incoming and outgoing Nike products, orderpicking, labelling and packaging orders.

We are looking for all-round employees, who are flexible to rotate over several area’s and tasks.

Nike has excellent on-the-job training so you don’t need to have any relevant work experience; enthusiasm and willingness to learn are far more important!

 

	
• Your knowledge of English is very good (you can find vacancies for Dutch speaking candidates on www.startpeople.be/nike)	
• You want a full-time job and are eager to outperform during peak periods (working extended during weekends)	
• You want to work in an early and late shift pattern (06h00-14h00 Mon-Fri, 14h00-22h00 the week after)	
• You have your own means of transportation (the Nike campus is not accessible by bus or train)	
• You are looking forward to having a dynamic job that requires you to walk a lot and lift heavy orders (+/- 20 kg on a regular basis)

jobs.occupation: Bus Mechanic – good salary + training opportunies

• You carry out maintenance and repairs on buses.

• You diagnose mechanical issues and fix them efficiently.

• You perform preventive maintenance to keep vehicles in top condition.

• You work on a varied fleet of different brands and models.

For a company in the Tielt region, active in the food industry, we are looking for a motivated and reliable Packaging Operator.

• Preparing products for the packaging process.

• You like working with vegetables

• Checking the quality of packaged products.

• Monitoring the packaging and production process.

Your profile:

• Experience in production or machine operation is an advantage.

• Willingness to work during the day

• Reliable, accurate and motivated.

• Able to work independently as well as part of a team.

• Good work ethic and a responsible attitude.

Do you like working with machines and keeping production running smoothly? As a Production Operator in the food industry, you play a key role in ensuring a stable, efficient and safe production process. You work in a modern production environment where teamwork, responsibility and quality matter.

• You start up, operate and adjust production machines throughout the shift.

• You monitor the production process and intervene when adjustments are needed.

• You troubleshoot minor technical issues and contact maintenance when necessary.

• You communicate clearly with fellow operators to ensure smooth collaboration.

• You help guarantee production continuity through good organisation and coordination.

Our client is an international company with various fields of expertise in the medical and pharmaceutical sector. You will work within a specific division of the company, dedicated to a field of expertise.

Jobomschrijving

 As a GL Accountant, you will work both autonomously and in support of the Chief Accountant in carrying out various tasks within statutory accounting and ensuring compliance with tax obligations:

• Daily accounting entries in AP, AR and GL
• Ensuring accuracy of all data
• Reconciliation of accounts
• Monthly and yearly closings
• Preparation and analysis of cash flow 
• Preparation of the financial statements (BE GAAP)
• Financial reporting to group
• VAT-declaration and statutory reporting NBB / Intrastat
• Assisting with external audits and internal controls
• Supporting process improvements and automation initiatives
• Acting as a point of contact within the finance team

The succesful candidate ideally matches the following criteria:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance
• 5-10 years of experience in a similar accounting role
• Strong knowledge of Belgian GAAP
• Experience in a small or medium-sized international structure is a strong asset
• Solid hands-on accounting expertise with an end-to-end view
• Fluent in English
• Good command of French (invoices and local documentation)
• Knowledge of Dutch is a plus
• Autonomous, reliable and detail-oriented
• Comfortable in a small team with broad responsibilities
• Hands-on mindset with a pragmatic and flexible attitude

Our client is a leading international corporate real estate company. You will join a company offering a stable environment, strong team spirit and opportunities to develop your skills. They are located in Diegem close to a train station in a new modern building.

Jobomschrijving

As Meetings & Event Coordinator, you will ensure successful planning and execution of meetings and events.

• Coordinate and support delivery of meetings, conferences and events from planning to execution.
• Prepare and set up meeting rooms and event spaces.
• Coordinate guest services, catering, transportation and other event-related logistics.
• Manage meetings and events calendar and contribute to post-event reporting and follow-up.
• Support in general office management.

• First experience in events, hospitality, office management or administration is a plus (internships included).
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Service-oriented mindset and professional communication skills.
• Proactive, hands-on and able to work in a fast-paced environment.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word and Excel).
